title: Opportunity Quick Score
purpose: Demonstrate Run 014 on a real bounded software assignment by building a small internal decision-support application.
userOutcome: A user can name an opportunity, score five dimensions from 1 to 10, and receive a deterministic Build, Validate, or Kill recommendation with rationale.
acceptanceCriteria: Five score inputs: demand, speed-to-cash, margin, automation fit, competition advantage.
Weighted score is deterministic and displayed as 0-100.
Recommendation is BUILD at 75+, VALIDATE at 55-74, KILL below 55.
Competition advantage is scored positively: higher means a more defensible opportunity.
Changing any score immediately recalculates result and rationale.
Reset restores the documented sample state.
All form controls have accessible labels and keyboard operation.
No network requests or runtime dependencies are required.
